Before review, please check:

- [ ] The description links an issue (`Closes #123`), or this is a trivial fix
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docstrings and documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] The PR title is a conventional commit subject

We squash-merge, so your branch lands on `develop` as one commit. The PR title becomes its
subject and the release note. If the change deserves more than one entry in the change log,
add the extra conventional subjects at the very bottom of the description.

[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/IS3UniCologne/urban-mobility-simulation/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-request-titles-and-commit-messages)
has the details.
